name: VRG Pro+ 3D VR Headset
description:
Specification:
Name: VR glasses for mobile phones
Brand: VRG
Model: VRG Pro+
Material: ABS
Lenses: Standard model - uncoated lens, Blu-ray model - HD Blu-ray coated lens (optional)
Lens diameter: about 42mm/1.65in
Viewing angle: 120°
Myopia Support: Adjustable within 800 degrees of both eyes
Pupil adjustment: about 60-75mm/2.36-2.95in
Compatible platforms: for iOS, for Android
Applicable to: 5-7 inch smartphone
Plug Type: Straight Plug
Wearing method: Head-mounted
Comes with headphones and buttons, or functions such as volume adjustment and playback pause.
VR glasses size: 19cmx20cmx11cm
Product net weight: 368g
